components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant CTA. One per section maximum.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: var(--color-accent-orange); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-orange); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition: transform 100ms ease-out; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent at rest, light fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-text-dark); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-dark); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--color-border-light); border-color: var(--color-text-dark); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-orange); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition: transform 100ms ease-out; }

components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(27, 42, 65, 0.06); padding: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; transition: all 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(27, 42, 65, 0.08); border-color: rgba(27, 42, 65, 0.12); } .ds-card-avatar { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--color-accent-bg); color: var(--color-accent-orange); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-dark); } .ds-card-role { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category and rating filter pills. 44px min touch target.
components.css: .ds-chip { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-dark); color: var(--color-text-secondary); padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-orange); color: var(--color-accent-orange); } .ds-chip--active { background-color: var(--color-accent-orange); border-color: var(--color-accent-orange); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip--active:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent-hover); }

narrative.overview:
AdFreelancin is a structured, professional environment that conveys the safety and reliability of pre-vetted consultants. The visual system pairs a deep navy authority layer with a single restrained orange accent, creating an interface that reads as institutional and trustworthy rather than playful or speculative.

The system rejects two common failure modes: the cluttered, low-trust aesthetic of traditional freelance boards, and the saturated AI-style templates that dominate modern generated interfaces. Instead, AdFreelancin occupies a disciplined middle ground — clean enough to feel modern, dense enough to feel useful, and restrained enough to feel safe.
keyCharacteristics: Navy authority: dark navy header and footer frame the workspace with institutional weight
Restrained orange energy: accent appears only on primary CTAs, active states, and verified badges
Flat at rest, depth on demand: shadows appear only in response to hover and focus
Single typeface discipline: one font family at carefully controlled weights

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Verified Orange appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity signals importance: if everything is orange, nothing is.

rules.name: The Weight Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: 800 → 700 → 600 → 500 → 400. Weight always decreases as you move down the hierarchy. Never use 800 on body text; never use 400 on a heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus). A card sitting idle has a 1px border and no shadow; it earns its depth on interaction.

dos: Do use Verified Orange exclusively for primary CTAs, active states, and verified badges.
Do maintain the flat-at-rest, depth-on-demand elevation philosophy.
Do enforce 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive controls.
Do use the 2px orange :focus-visible outline on every focusable element.
Do use transform and opacity for all animations.
Do reference design tokens for every color value.
donts: Don't use saturated AI-style template defaults: beige backgrounds, text gradients, or over-rounded 32px+ card corners.
Don't create cluttered, low-trust layouts with excessive visual noise, popups, or competing CTAs.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves.
Don't pair a border with a wide soft shadow on the same element at rest.
Don't use more than one font family.
Don't allow any text to fall below WCAG AA contrast.
